title: Italian triangle pylon
description: Italy uses many triangle pylons (three half crossarms in a staggered pattern), seen almost everywhere. Very large ones have a peak, but even smaller ones often have no peak at all, which is very typical of Italy. Spain also has many, with a different design; Greece has none.

title: Italian delta pylon
description: Italy has some unique Delta pylons: an arch in the beam, a beam that is sometimes off centre, or a tower body rotated by 45° with a very sharp triangular hole. A generic Delta design found in almost every country also exists.
